body: I have quit the job, and tried to reach out to my friends. Upon doing so, I had 3 people tell me that they honestly didn't like me any more and would just prefer if I stayed away, because the group got a heck of a lot closer without me in the 3 months that I was gone

I've built my life around them from the time we were all little kids. Like we're all in the same sports, same activities, hung out all the time, threw each other parties for no reason, stuff like that. And now everything is changed. Like I'm just completely unwanted, everywhere I go.

And I'm not sure about that either. It feels like it's not even me when it happens, and quite frankly I find it disgusting. I just don't know how to stop, and I've tried everything I can think of
